rationale: Glucose depleted; switching to lactate and arabinose fermentation with arginine as nitrogen source. Mixed-acid fermentation under anaerobic conditions produces acetate, formate, and propionate. Carbon balance: 35 mmol in (8+15+12) minus 9 mmol for growth minus ~12 mmol for fermentation products = sustainable. Nitrogen from arginine covers biosynthetic demand with minor recycling.
